title: Monotonicity of head bounds
statement: For a Boolean Turing-machine configuration $c$ with $k$ work tapes and natural numbers $A\le B$, if every work-tape head of $c$ lies in $[-A,A]$, then every work-tape head of $c$ lies in $[-B,B]$.
